description: Angular component for import/export CSV dialog in Thingsboard UI, handling CSV parsing, column mapping, and error display.

classes.name: ImportDialogCsvComponent
classes.description: Angular component for CSV import dialog, managing CSV parsing, column assignment, and error display.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Initializes column assignment after view is initialized.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Destroys ACE editor instance on component destruction.

methods.name: previousStep
methods.description: Navigates to the previous step in the import process.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Handles navigation to the next step, including CSV parsing and entity import.

methods.name: parseCSV
methods.description: Parses CSV data into JSON format using convertCSVToJson.

methods.name: createColumnsData
methods.description: Creates column mapping configuration based on CSV headers and data.

methods.name: addEntities
methods.description: Performs bulk import of entities based on CSV data.

methods.name: processingColumnsParams

methods.name: initEditor
methods.description: Initializes ACE editor to display errors.

methods.name: createEditor
methods.description: Creates and configures ACE editor instance for error display.
